name: 构成主义
description: 红黑奶油白的硬边几何与斜线对冲，纸面墨迹增强强烈的现代主义张力。
rendering_prompt: Use a forceful, limited palette of red, black, and cream, compressing the subject into hard-edged geometric color blocks. Bold lines, diagonal planes, and contrasting scales should create a driving visual rhythm. Simplify light and shade, subordinating details to clear contours. Add a little coarse paper grain and uneven vintage ink coverage. Organize composition through shape, angle, and visual weight for direct, energetic modernist tension.
avoid: 自动加标语、无关政治图像、柔软写实渐变
difference: 构成主义重对角线与动势；包豪斯重秩序与比例
tuning: 用形状角度和视觉重量产生力量，无需添加文字。
